cities: 69 stores across the US, including Scottsdale, Chicago, Albuquerque, and its own site

craft_evidence.owned: None shown. Claim only: the code of conduct mentions "UNTUCKit factories" but names none; the quality page says fabrics are "made exclusively for us by top-tier manufacturers across the world".
craft_evidence.makers: None. No product page read names a factory or maker (129 styles with fabric text read). Four Stretch Cotton shirts say they were made in an unnamed Fair Trade Certified factory (claim).
craft_evidence.mills: Evidence on 4 of 11 sport coats: Reda (Weberly, Mayhold), Lanificio TG di Fabio (Roger), Maggia (Holstein). None on shirts, knits or trousers. SUPIMA and TENCEL are fibre brands, not mills.
